frozen_note: Frozen before any parser execution on the fixture suite or the representative corpus (order 008-a, requirement 3). Post-hoc changes require a recorded strategy-approved rationale.

P2.description: P1 + YAML-style metadata blocks (front matter is named by the frozen structural policy)

measurement_adapter.label: MEASUREMENT ADAPTER - research-only, NOT a runtime interface
measurement_adapter.rationale: The stock CLI --events mode emits offset ranges only in Rust Debug text format, which is not a stable machine-readable contract for a deterministic evaluator. The adapter uses the identical pinned crate (0.13.4, same registry checksum) and adds no dependencies; the stock CLI is still used for independent offset cross-checks.
measurement_adapter.stdout: one JSON line per event: {"i":<idx>,"k":"<kind token>","s":<start_byte>,"e":<end_byte>} followed by {"eof":true}

structural_policy.candidate_rule: A Text event is candidate prose iff its open-tag ancestor set intersects PROSE_CONTAINERS and does not intersect NON_PROSE_CONTAINERS.
notes: Link destinations/titles and image structure are never Text events, so they are protected by construction.
Strikethrough/superscript/subscript content is conservatively suppressed (policy names emphasis/strong only); recorded as a tradeoff, not a failure.
Markdown syntax/delimiters, list markers, heading markers, quote markers, line endings, table pipes and math delimiters are never Text events and thus never candidate prose.

Bare JSON, YAML/TOML/config, shell, paths, env vars, identifier-heavy tokens, TeX and dialect-missed URLs are residual semantic categories: exposure is the bounded second-stage problem, not a safety failure.

coordinate_contract.unit: byte offsets into the original UTF-8 input bytes
invariants: 0 <= s <= e <= len(input_bytes) for every event range
s and e lie on UTF-8 code-point boundaries (no code-point bisection)
input_bytes[s:e] is the exact intended original source slice
byte<->code-point mapping is deterministic and exactly reversible: cp = len(bytes[:s].decode('utf-8')); byte = len(text[:cp].encode('utf-8'))
coordinate_contract.disqualification: Any source-coordinate failure is an immediate NO-GO until explained and repaired upstream or through a trivial mapping layer (order predeclared acceptance, Hard).

predeclared_order: 1 install/pin candidate in reproducible machine-local environment
2 establish exact CLI/library identity (version, checksum, tag, license, MSRV, dependencies)
3 run difficult-case fixture suite (50 fixtures, 38 required classes + 12 extras)
increment1.stop_condition: If the fundamental source-range premise fails (any Hard invariant violation on the fixture suite), stop the round and report NO-GO evidence; do not continue merely because work was planned.

gate_checkpoint.description: Increment 1 evidence is durably committed and the predeclared conditions below are evaluated before any Increment 2 work. This round executes as a single reported round (the order's declared single-report publication structure), so the strategy review gate is enforced by the strategy final-head review before merge; the gate-crossing decision and evidence are recorded in results/increment1/gate-decision.json and in the OAP report.
proceed_conditions: Hard: 100% exact source-range fidelity on the fixture suite (all profiles)
Hard: no range splits a UTF-8 code point (all profiles)
Hard: structurally recognized code and math are never exposed as candidate prose (P1/P2 for math; all profiles for code/HTML)
Hard: link destinations remain protected; prose-bearing containers expose textual leaves
Hard: processing bounded and deterministic (identical rerun -> identical bytes)
Stock-CLI cross-check: adapter event ranges agree with the stock CLI --events ranges on all fixtures

stock_cli_crosscheck.invocation: --events plus the profile flags --enable-tables --enable-strikethrough --enable-tasklists --enable-math for P1 (and the P2-equivalent set where applicable); P0 = no flags
stock_cli_crosscheck.comparison: multiset of (event-top-kind, start_byte, end_byte) must match the adapter output

increment2.precondition: Increment 1 gate checkpoint proceeds (all proceed_conditions true).

corpus_selection.resolution: roots resolved at run time from the machine's persistent research runtime parent (private path, never committed); case files cases/dassle-spelling/*.json and cases/dassle-spelling-preservation/*.json; field dataset.input is the preserved real LLM output
corpus_selection.population: unique dataset.input texts across the three roots and both benchmark directories, deduplicated by sha256 of the text bytes
corpus_selection.sampling: first 100 entries in ascending sha256 order of the unique population (deterministic, non-curated)
constraints: raw text never leaves the private root; receipt carries counts/categories/hashes only

differential.side_a: research/curated/protected.py protected_intervals (current hand-written protection, code-point coordinates)
differential.side_b: adapter profile P2 candidate-prose set (frozen structural policy), byte coordinates mapped to code points
differential.disagreement_unit: maximal span of the symmetric difference of the two protected sets

consequence_classes.1: parser correctly exposes over-protected prose (B exposes, A protected, content prose-like)
consequence_classes.2: parser correctly protects previously exposed non-prose (B protected, A exposed, content machine-like)
consequence_classes.3: parser falsely exposes machine-significant content (B exposes, A protected, content parser-recognized-machine: code/HTML/math/link-dest/image) - SAFETY class
consequence_classes.4: parser unnecessarily suppresses valid prose (B protected, A exposed, content prose-like)
consequence_classes.5: source-coordinate mismatch (both protect the same construct but boundaries differ)
consequence_classes.6: malformed-input safety difference (example flagged malformed; protection state differs)
consequence_classes.7: expected residual semantic category (content in residual set: paren/bracket TeX, begin-end TeX, bare JSON, YAML/TOML/config, shell, paths, env vars, identifier-heavy tokens, numbers, dialect-missed URLs/autolinks)
consequence_classes.8: unresolved needing inspection (classifier cannot decide deterministically)

content_kind_rules.prose: tokens are alphabetic (Latin incl. Slovenian diacritics), no digits/underscore/structural punctuation, >=60% alphabetic bytes
content_kind_rules.span_rule: classify maximal whitespace-free sub-tokens; span kind = majority kind with priority-order tiebreak; if mixed and no majority, kind = mixed

trigger_conditions: structural misclassification affecting actual Qwen output
challenger.decision_recorded: trigger decision (triggered/not-triggered with evidence) is recorded either way in results/increment2/challenger-decision.json
challenger.note: tree-sitter-markdown is not revived absent materially new evidence contradicting the maintainers' warning; Pandoc is a diagnostic oracle only, not a runtime candidate

hard: 100% exact source-range fidelity on the deterministic fixture suite
no range splits a UTF-8 sequence
structurally recognized code and math are never exposed as candidate prose
HTML/metadata protected per frozen policy; link destinations remain protected
prose-bearing Markdown containers still expose their textual leaves
malformed structural cases follow documented deterministic behaviour
no parse/re-render/reconstruction requirement; processing bounded and deterministic
acceptance.safety: zero false exposures of protected machine content in the frozen adversarial suite for constructs the parser claims to recognize structurally
acceptance.coverage: report actual over-protection losses in headings/lists/blockquotes/table cells/link labels/emphasis-strong; no arbitrary percentage
acceptance.residual: GO requires remaining exposed machine-significant content to fall into the bounded residual set, not evidence of fundamental unsuitability

outcome_states.GO: structural/source-range contract validated; residual gaps bounded and suitable for a second stage
outcome_states.CONDITIONAL_GO: core parser suitable; one or more bounded questions need a targeted follow-up
outcome_states.NO_GO: fundamental assumption fails (unreliable source spans, unsafe recovery on relevant constructs, unacceptable common-format failures, or residual problem not actually small); trigger the challenger path

rules: no raw private LLM outputs in Git or public reports
no private absolute paths in committed documents
no wall-clock values in any committed aggregate that affects classification
identical rerun of every committed tool on the same inputs produces identical output bytes
